observations: The first page of the Latin text; the page number, 1, is not printed at the head. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «1» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

L01-L02: the title, «Incipit ezich Elkaurezmi per Athelardum Bathoniensem ex arabico sumptus», in a larger type, centred, with a short rule below it. In the right margin beside it the folios of the four manuscripts at which the text begins: Mazarine (M) 82 recto, Chartres (C) 41 recto, Oxford (O) 99 verso, Madrid (N) 8 recto; transcribed as margin notes.

The apparatus (N01-N13), in a smaller type, gives the readings of the manuscripts by their sigla C, O, M and N; the lemma closes with a square bracket; «om.» (omitted), «suprascr.» (written above) and the remarks of the editor in italics. N01: the omission in the lemma is printed as four points, in N04, N05 and N07 as three. The text and the apparatus follow the editor's principles of p. XXIII (JP2 0027): ae for the e of the manuscripts, v for consonantal u, t for c before i and a vowel.
N01: the semicolons of the apparatus stand after a thin space (9 px), as in the German pages.

critical_notes.evidence: the note on «meridie quartae feriae» is note 3 (L04 «feriae{sup:3})»); the number is printed 2, a second time after the note 2 on «statum» in the same line
the note numbers of the text are followed by a bracket on the line, «13)», «15)»; after the raised 14 of «ezich» the bracket is not printed
